episodes.title: She Escaped a Polygamist Cult, Then Federal Prison | Marana Johnson on Claim Your Voice
episodes.description:
What does it take to find your voice after a lifetime of being told to stay quiet?

This week on Claim Your Voice, I’m joined by Marana Johnson, a mother, author, and entrepreneur who grew up in the polygamist community of Short Creek. You may have seen her on the Netflix docuseries Trust Me: The False Prophet. Marana shares her journey from extreme obedience and 18 months in federal prison to rebuilding her life with purpose.

We talk about how one moment at age eight shaped her sense of worth, why so many women lose their voice in childhood, and the questions she’s learned to ask herself on the way to healing. Her message: a way out is a way in.

🎙 ABOUT MARANA JOHNSON
Marana is the founder of Positivity Labs, which creates affirmation jewelry and experiences. She is working on a book and an upcoming documentary, sharing her story in her own voice.
